021import net.tnemc.core.currency.Denomination;
022import net.tnemc.core.currency.item.ItemCurrency;
023import net.tnemc.item.AbstractItemStack;
024import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
025import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.log.DebugLevel;
026
027import java.math.BigDecimal;
028import java.math.RoundingMode;
029import java.util.Collection;
030import java.util.Map;
031import java.util.TreeMap;
032
033/**
034 * ItemCalculations
035 *
036 * @author creatorfromhell
037 * @since 0.1.2.0
038 */
039public class ItemCalculations<I> {
040
041  /**
042   * Used to calculate the holdings of the inventory materials present.
043   *
044   * @return The {@link BigDecimal} representation of the inventory materials balance value.
045   */
046  public BigDecimal calculateHoldings(final CalculationData<I> data) {
047
048    BigDecimal holdings = BigDecimal.ZERO;
049
050    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Denomination> entry : data.getDenominations().entrySet()) {
051      final int amount = data.getInventoryMaterials().getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0);
052
053      if(amount > 0) {
054        holdings = holdings.add(entry.getKey().multiply(new BigDecimal(amount)));
055      }
056    }
057    return holdings;
058  }
059
060  public void setItems(final CalculationData<I> data, final BigDecimal amount) {
061
062    final BigDecimal holdings = calculateHoldings(data);
063
064    if(holdings.compareTo(amount) == 0) return;
065
066    if(holdings.compareTo(amount) > 0) {
067      calculation(data, holdings.subtract(amount));
068      return;
069    }
070    provideMaterials(data, amount.subtract(holdings));
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Used to calculate the materials that need to be removed when a player in an item-based economy
075   * has money taken from their account.
076   *
077   * This is a rewritten version that fixes the change calculation bug where players were not
078   * receiving the correct amount of change when paying with larger denominations.
079   *
080   * @param amountToRemove The amount to remove from the player's account.
081   *
082   * @return The {@link BigDecimal} representation of the leftover amount that couldn't be removed
083   * because there's no more materials left to remove.
084   */
085  public BigDecimal calculation(final CalculationData<I> data, final BigDecimal amountToRemove) {
086
087    PluginCore.log().debug("=== Starting Calculation ===", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
088    PluginCore.log().debug("Amount to remove: " + amountToRemove.toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
089
090    // Create a copy of inventory materials
091    final TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> availableMaterials = new TreeMap<>(data.getInventoryMaterials());
092    final DirectPayment payment = calculateDirectPayment(availableMaterials, amountToRemove);
093
094    PluginCore.log().debug("After direct payment - paid: " + payment.paidAmount().toPlainString()
095                           + ", Remaining: " + payment.remaining().toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
096
097    // If more is still needed to pay, break down a larger denomination
098    BigDecimal changeToGiveBack = BigDecimal.ZERO;
099
100    if(payment.remaining().compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
101      final Breakdown breakdown = findBreakdown(data, availableMaterials, payment);
102      if(breakdown == null) {
103        PluginCore.log().debug("Cannot pay - insufficient funds", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
104        return payment.remaining();
105      }
106      changeToGiveBack = breakdown.change();
107    }
108
109    executeRemovals(data, payment.toRemove());
110
111    // Give back change if any
112    if(changeToGiveBack.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
113
114      PluginCore.log().debug("Providing change: " + changeToGiveBack.toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
115      provideMaterials(data, changeToGiveBack);
116    }
117
118    PluginCore.log().debug("=== Calculation Completed ===", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
119    return BigDecimal.ZERO;
120  }
121
122  private DirectPayment calculateDirectPayment(final TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> availableMaterials,
123                                               final BigDecimal amountToRemove) {
124
125    BigDecimal paidAmount = BigDecimal.ZERO;
126    BigDecimal remaining = amountToRemove;
127    final TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> toRemove = new TreeMap<>();
128
129    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Integer> entry : availableMaterials.descendingMap().entrySet()) {
130      final BigDecimal denomination = entry.getKey();
131      if(denomination.compareTo(remaining) > 0) {
132        continue;
133      }
134
135      final int needed = remaining.divide(denomination, 0, RoundingMode.DOWN).intValue();
136      final int toUse = Math.min(needed, entry.getValue());
137      if(toUse > 0) {
138        toRemove.put(denomination, toUse);
139        final BigDecimal value = denomination.multiply(new BigDecimal(toUse));
140        paidAmount = paidAmount.add(value);
141        remaining = remaining.subtract(value);
142        PluginCore.log().debug("Using " + toUse + "x " + denomination.toPlainString()
143                               + " = " + value.toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
144      }
145      if(remaining.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) == 0) {
146        break;
147      }
148    }
149    return new DirectPayment(paidAmount, remaining, toRemove);
150  }
151
152  private Breakdown findBreakdown(final CalculationData<I> data,
153                                  final TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> availableMaterials,
154                                  final DirectPayment payment) {
155
156    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Integer> entry : availableMaterials.entrySet()) {
157      final BigDecimal denomination = entry.getKey();
158      if(denomination.compareTo(payment.remaining()) <= 0 || entry.getValue() <= 0) {
159        continue;
160      }
161
162      final int alreadyUsed = payment.toRemove().getOrDefault(denomination, 0);
163      if(entry.getValue() > alreadyUsed) {
164        final BigDecimal change = denomination.subtract(payment.remaining());
165        PluginCore.log().debug("Breaking down 1x " + denomination.toPlainString()
166                               + ", change: " + change.toPlainString(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
167        payment.toRemove().put(denomination, alreadyUsed + 1);
168        return new Breakdown(data.getDenominations().get(denomination), change);
169      }
170    }
171    return null;
172  }
173
174  private void executeRemovals(final CalculationData<I> data,
175                               final TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> toRemove) {
176
177    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Integer> entry : toRemove.entrySet()) {
178      final Denomination denomination = data.getDenominations().get(entry.getKey());
179      PluginCore.log().debug("Removing " + entry.getValue() + "x " + entry.getKey().toPlainString(),
180                             DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
181      data.removeMaterials(denomination, entry.getValue());
182    }
183  }
184
185  private record DirectPayment(BigDecimal paidAmount, BigDecimal remaining,
186                               TreeMap<BigDecimal, Integer> toRemove) { }
187
188  private record Breakdown(Denomination denomination, BigDecimal change) { }
189
190  /**
191   * Used to exchange an amount to inventory items. This is mostly used for when a larger
192   * denomination needs to be broken into smaller denominations for calculation purposes.
193   *
194   * @param amount The amount that the items should add up to.
195   */
196  public void provideMaterials(final CalculationData<I> data, final BigDecimal amount) {
197
198    data.getCalculator().initialize(data.getCurrency(), data.getInventoryMaterials());
199
200    for(final Map.Entry<BigDecimal, Integer> entry : data.getCalculator().breakdown(amount).entrySet()) {
201
202      final int holding = data.getInventoryMaterials().getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0);
203      data.getInventoryMaterials().put(entry.getKey(), holding + entry.getValue());
204      data.provideMaterials(data.getDenominations().get(entry.getKey()), entry.getValue());
205    }
206  }
207
208  /**
209   * Used to remove tiers from the {@link CalculationData} being worked with.
210   *
211   * @param denom  The denom name in String form.
212   * @param amount The amount of the material to remove from working materials.
213   */
214  public void removeMaterials(final CalculationData<I> data, final Denomination denom, final Integer amount) {
215
216    data.removeMaterials(denom, amount);
217  }
218
219  /**
220   * Platform hook used to place item payouts into nested containers (such as shulkers).
221   *
222   * @param left The stacks still left after normal insertion attempts.
223   * @param inventory The target inventory object.
224   * @param currency The item currency being processed.
225   * @return The stacks that still could not be inserted.
226   */
227  public Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> tryInsertIntoContainers(final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> left,
228                                                                        final I inventory,
229                                                                        final ItemCurrency currency) {
230
231    return left;
232  }
233}
